description: Accessibility findings for every same-origin page in a site's sitemap (max 50 pages) in one combined stored report, priced from the sitemap before payment (x402): $0.05 per page for the first 25 pages, $0.02 per page beyond (price RULED). Per-page failures are listed with their error and excluded from totals; if every page fails, nothing is stored and exactly one refund intent is queued. Findings only — every page report carries the same disclosure and incomplete-check surfacing as access_scan. Call access_crawl_preflight first for the exact price preview for free. Price per call is the tiered sitemap total (RULED). — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/access/crawl.
name: access_crawl
